Localization.Name: Crusader Industries
Localization.Description: Makers of an extensive fleet of cargo, vehicle and data transport ships, and cutting edge shuttles, Crusader Industries is a titan of the aerospace industry. It is a company so powerful and prominent that it purchased a gas giant in the Stanton system to house its current headquarters.

Localization.Name: Crusader C2 Hercules Starlifter
Localization.Description:
Manufacturer: Crusader Industries
Focus: Medium Freight

Utilizing the patented Hercules military-grade spaceframe and expanding cargo capacity, while sacrificing barely any firepower, the C2 has taken the private sector by storm. It has become the industry standard for racing teams, ship dealers and manufacturers, construction orgs, mining corporations, and even large-scale touring entertainment outfits.
